requiredBehaviors.behavior: flag excessive empty container area as a major composition issue
requiredBehaviors.evidence: v0.2 explicitly classifies dominant oversized mostly empty containers as a major excessive-container-area finding.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: flag insufficient conclusion dominance and weak reading progression
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Weak visual progression and insufficient conclusion dominance are mandatory composition checks with major severity conditions.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: treat unreadable or footer-conflicting source text as a major finding
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Undersized or unsafe source text is explicitly major when it is practically unreadable or conflicts with footer/branding zones.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat dead space inside dominant cards as high-quality whitespace
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The contract distinguishes useful whitespace from dead space inside dominant UI/card elements.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: approve the slide solely because structural collision checks pass
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The completion rule prevents layout PASS for collision-free but compositionally weak slides.
